name: spellkave_attach_map_layer
label: Attach Map Layer
description: Author a [[map_layers]] backdrop pointer for a place_graph. Does NOT vendor the image — asset_path resolves at map_graph time via SPELLKAVE_MAP_ASSETS_ROOT/<asset_module> or FVTT_DATA_ROOT. The caller names asset_module, source_kind and posture; nothing is assumed. Optionally stamps provenance metadata on the graph. When the file is present, image_width/height are filled from PNG IHDR if unset.

asset_path.description: Relative path under the asset module, e.g. "maps/hamlet.jpg".

asset_module.description: Asset module id: the folder that holds the image. Resolves SPELLKAVE_MAP_ASSETS_ROOT/<module> and FVTT_DATA_ROOT/<module>. No default.

posture.description: License posture stamp of the image, e.g. "cc-by-4.0" or "proprietary". No default.

source_kind.description: Where the image comes from, e.g. "first-party" or a named map source. No default.

map_id.description: Catalog map id for provenance payload.

license_url.description: License text URL for the provenance payload. No default.

source_url.description: Source page URL for the provenance payload. No default.

promptSnippet: Attach an out-of-repo map image layer to a place_graph
promptGuidelines: Use after author_place. Pass asset_module + asset_path maps/<file>, plus source_kind and posture.
Images never go in git; map_graph overlays them when SPELLKAVE_MAP_ASSETS_ROOT/<asset_module> resolves.
just map-font-check is unrelated — this is bitmap backdrops, not terminal fonts.
